Self.Wiki: This map object represents a platoon setup for an ensemble of characters.

PlatoonScriptID.Wiki: The platoon script to use for this ensemble. 100 on most retail platoons.

State.Wiki: The platoon's starting reflect state; AI scripts change it later (SetReflectState). On for 13 retail platoons.

GroupPartsNames.Wiki: A character that belongs to this platoon.
